detail: Rainbow Childrens Medicare Limited, a healthcare chain operator listed on NSE, submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE on 1–3 July 2026 under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This is a mandatory filing triggered by acquisition or change in substantial shareholding (typically ≥5%). The disclosure document lodged with the exchange contains the identity of the acquiring party, number of shares acquired, acquisition price, and relevant exemptions or conditions under the takeover code. Full transaction terms require review of the actual disclosure PDF.
